resourceModel.upstreamDerivation: The pinned OpenTURNS implementation evaluates every input HSIC statistic for every output permutation; four additional all-variable passes conservatively cover covariance, observed and normalized indices, and asymptotic diagnostics.

auditAnswers.hiddenLoopNesting: Yes. Each permutation recomputes the HSIC statistic for every input dimension, so dimension and permutation counts multiply rather than add.
auditAnswers.maximumConfiguration: The schema maximum n=500, d=20, B=200 estimates 1,071,000,000 units and is rejected before sampling because it exceeds the 150,000,000-unit cap.
auditAnswers.uiMaximumDimension: The UI default n=250 and B=100 at the supported maximum d=20 estimates 136,500,000 units, remains below the cap, and is asserted through a browser request contract.

browserTests: apps/web/e2e/ui-flows.spec.ts#keeps target HSIC UI defaults within the maximum-dimensional core resource envelope
apps/web/e2e/full-stack/journey.spec.ts#retained-user journey persists a project, executes every plugin, and produces a durable report
interpretationBoundaries: Target-domain HSIC measures association with a smoothed critical-domain score; it is not a failure-probability estimator or variance allocation.
The result does not establish causal influence or predictive validity outside the declared sampled input distribution.
